import hashlib, json, re
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

folder = Path('products/services/buyer-request-screen')
source = folder / '2026-11-26-uk-ocds-tender-page.json'
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '446a3dca8f0b7364e63655590a3d1975a3703a5095c0918f874d2ac4a3f8219a', digest
package = json.loads(raw)
cutoff = datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-26T09:30:27+00:00')
terms = re.compile(r'\b(?:reconcil\w*|data migration|data quality|data cleansing|data validation|export validation|import validation|data mapping|data deduplication)\b', re.I)

def deadline_state(value):
    try:
        deadline = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        if deadline.tzinfo is not None:
            return 'after_cutoff' if deadline > cutoff else 'at_or_before_cutoff'
    except (AttributeError, ValueError):
        pass
    return 'unknown'

rows = []
for release in package['releases']:
    tender = release.get('tender') or {}
    deadline = (tender.get('tenderPeriod') or {}).get('endDate')
    for scope, record in [('tender', tender)] + [('lot', lot) for lot in tender.get('lots', [])]:
        title = record.get('title') or ''
        description = record.get('description') or ''
        matches = list(terms.finditer(description))[:4]
        rows.append({'release_id': release.get('id'), 'ocid': release.get('ocid'), 'tag': release.get('tag'), 'buyer': (release.get('buyer') or {}).get('name'), 'scope': scope, 'lot_id': record.get('id') if scope == 'lot' else None, 'title': title, 'tender_status': tender.get('status'), 'scope_status': record.get('status'), 'tender_deadline': deadline, 'deadline_state': deadline_state(deadline), 'title_matches': terms.findall(title), 'description_excerpts': [description[max(0, m.start()-100):m.end()+160] for m in matches], 'documents': [{'id': d.get('id'), 'url': d.get('url'), 'document_type': d.get('documentType')} for d in record.get('documents', [])]})

candidates = [row for row in rows if row['deadline_state'] == 'after_cutoff' and row['tender_status'] == 'active' and row['scope_status'] in (None, 'active') and (row['title_matches'] or row['description_excerpts'])]
candidates.sort(key=lambda row: (bool(row['description_excerpts']), row['scope'] == 'lot', bool(row['title_matches'])), reverse=True)
result = {'source': str(source), 'source_sha256': digest, 'cutoff': cutoff.isoformat(), 'release_count': len(package['releases']), 'scope_count': len(rows), 'scope_rows': rows, 'candidate_count': len(candidates), 'candidate_pointers': candidates[:3], 'limits': 'Keyword and structured status screen of one captured page. Missing deadlines and titles without the selected terms can hide relevant notices. Confirm separability, current deadline, acceptance criteria, eligibility and submission route in the original before preparing a quote.'}
out = folder / '2026-11-26-uk-ocds-quote-pointers.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(json.dumps({'release_count': result['release_count'], 'scope_count': len(rows), 'candidate_count': len(candidates), 'candidate_pointers': candidates[:3]}, ensure_ascii=False))
